fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line into the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Count
fusions.desc: A snagging strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target (max 40%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Trawl Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 6-tile line for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward.

fusions.name: Next on the Line
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a barbed line snags the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
